Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_194502.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

module origen_194502(
    input [5:0] opcode,
    input [5:0] func,
    input zf,
    output reg [1:0] sel_dest,
    output reg [1:0] sel_data,
    output reg [1:0] sel_pc,
    output reg sel_opA,
    output reg sel_opB,
    output reg wr_en,
    output reg data_wr,
    output reg [5:0] alu_op
);

    parameter R_TYPE = 6'b000000;
    parameter ADDI = 6'b001000;
    parameter SLTI = 6'b001010;
    parameter LW = 6'b100011;
    parameter SW = 6'b101011;
    parameter BEQ = 6'b000100;
    parameter BNE = 6'b000101;
    parameter JUMP = 6'b000010;
    parameter JAL = 6'b000011;
    parameter JR = 6'b001000;

    parameter ADD = 6'b100000;
    parameter SUB = 6'b100010;
    parameter SLT = 6'b101010;
    parameter SLL = 6'b000000;
    parameter SRL = 6'b000010;

    always @(*) begin
        case (opcode)
            R_TYPE: begin
                sel_dest = 2'b01;
                sel_data = 2'b00;
                sel_pc = 2'b00;
                sel_opA = 1'b0;
                sel_opB = 1'b0;
                wr_en = 1'b1;
                data_wr = 1'b0;
                case (func)
                    ADD: alu_op = 6'b100000;
                    SUB: alu_op = 6'b100010;
                    SLT: alu_op = 6'b101010;
                    SLL: alu_op = 6'b000000;
                    SRL: alu_op = 6'b000010;
                    JR: begin
                        sel_pc = 2'b11;
                        wr_en = 1'b0;
                    end
                    default: alu_op = 6'b000000;
                endcase
            end
            ADDI: begin
                sel_dest = 2'b01;
                sel_data = 2'b00;
                sel_pc = 2'b00;
                sel_opA = 1'b0;
                sel_opB = 1'b1;
                wr_en = 1'b1;
                data_wr = 1'b0;
                alu_op = 6'b100000;
            end
            SLTI: begin
                sel_dest = 2'b01;
                sel_data = 2'b00;
                sel_pc = 2'b00;
                sel_opA = 1'b0;
                sel_opB = 1'b1;
                wr_en = 1'b1;
                data_wr = 1'b0;
                alu_op = 6'b101010;
            end
            LW: begin
                sel_dest = 2'b01;
                sel_data = 2'b01;
                sel_pc = 2'b00;
                sel_opA = 1'b0;
                sel_opB = 1'b1;
                wr_en = 1'b1;
                data_wr = 1'b0;
                alu_op = 6'b100000;
            end
            SW: begin
                sel_dest = 2'b00;
                sel_data = 2'b00;
                sel_pc = 2'b00;
                sel_opA = 1'b0;
                sel_opB = 1'b1;
                wr_en = 1'b0;
                data_wr = 1'b1;
                alu_op = 6'b100000;
            end
            BEQ: begin
                sel_dest = 2'b00;
                sel_data = 2'b00;
                sel_pc = (zf) ? 2'b01 : 2'b00;
                sel_opA = 1'b0;
                sel_opB = 1'b0;
                wr_en = 1'b0;
                data_wr = 1'b0;
                alu_op = 6'b100010;
            end
            BNE: begin
                sel_dest = 2'b00;
                sel_data = 2'b00;
                sel_pc = (zf) ? 2'b00 : 2'b01;
                sel_opA = 1'b0;
                sel_opB = 1'b0;
                wr_en = 1'b0;
                data_wr = 1'b0;
                alu_op = 6'b100010;
            end
            JUMP: begin
                sel_dest = 2'b00;
                sel_data = 2'b00;
                sel_pc = 2'b10;
                sel_opA = 1'b0;
                sel_opB = 1'b0;
                wr_en = 1'b0;
                data_wr = 1'b0;
                alu_op = 6'b000000;
            end
            JAL: begin
                sel_dest = 2'b10;
                sel_data = 2'b11;
                sel_pc = 2'b10;
                sel_opA = 1'b0;
                sel_opB = 1'b0;
                wr_en = 1'b1;
                data_wr = 1'b0;
                alu_op = 6'b000000;
            end
            default: begin
                sel_dest = 2'b00;
                sel_data = 2'b00;
                sel_pc = 2'b00;
                sel_opA = 1'b0;
                sel_opB = 1'b0;
                wr_en = 1'b0;
                data_wr = 1'b0;
                alu_op = 6'b000000;
            end
        endcase
    end

endmodule
STAGE 2

Generate the module

InputThe generated Stage 1 specification plus the required top-module name origen_194502.
InstructionImplement the complete synthesizable RTL module from the generated specification.

Protocol summary; the Stage 2 runner creates a fresh prompt.

OutputReconstructed complete RTL module.
Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.

Private final evaluation

Reference RTLClean RTL in the imported source record; hidden from Stage 2.
Score / oracleBinary formal equivalence to the hidden clean module

The formal oracle consumes the complete Stage 2 RTL file and compares it with the clean reference. A golden RTL file is scoring material, not a generated Stage 1 output.
